name: Sanu Gold Corp.
summary: Sanu Gold Corp. is actively involved in identifying, assessing, and advancing gold exploration and development projects across Guinea, West Africa. The company's primary asset is the Banta Baye property, a substantial area covering 99.9 square kilometers positioned northwest of the Kouroussa township in Guinea. Initially established in 2018 as Hibiki Capital Corp., the company rebranded as Sanu Gold Corp. in April 2021, and its corporate headquarters are located in Vancouver, Canada.
